text:
Mike H: quick q — proposing two new request-level knobs for SDK/API: `X-RW-Region-Hint` and `X-RW-Tier-Override`. goal = make smart routing deterministic for edge cases (quota exhaustion, regional failover).
Anya L: ok can you sketch the semantics? e.g., is tier override allowed for hosted customers?
Mike H: sketch: region-hint = best-effort, used for latency routing. tier-override = strong preference but still respects SLA/policy; only allowed for internal/debug or tenants with explicit permission.
Kevin T: +1 on best-effort. we need guardrails so users can't downgrade to contended tiers to save $$. also need telemetry tag to mark when fallback happened.
Sasha R: question about quotas — if customer sets `X-RW-Tier-Override:dedicated-burst` but quota is only hosted, should we reject or route with notice?
Mike H: prefer fallback route + annotated response header `X-RW-Routed-To` and `X-RW-Routing-Reason`. failure only for invalid/forbidden overrides (403).
Anya L: what about console UX? ops wants a per-tenant toggle to allow tier overrides + audit logs in console. also need to show % of requests that used region-hint vs auto routing.
devops-bot: deploy flagged: feature/route-headers is on rollout to staging (ff: route_headers_sdk)
Kevin T: telemetry bits: metrics we need = routed_by_hint.count, override_attempt.count, override_rejected.count, fallback_to_variant.count, routed_latency.p50/p95. add tag `routing.reason` (hint|quota|variant-fallback|region-unavailable).
Sasha R: SDK surface suggestion: param `routing: { regionHint: 'eu-west-1', tierOverride: 'beta' }` + header fallback. example:```js
// JS SDK
client.generate({
  prompt: 'xx',
  routing: { regionHint: 'eu-west-1', tierOverride: 'dedicated-burst' }
});
```
Mike H: server should treat header and SDK param as same priority; explicit query param `?rw_debug=1` beats both and attaches `X-RW-Debug: true` for internal tracing.
Anya L: security: tierOverride must be IAM-protected. audit log entry for any non-default routing. console should have toggle for audit retention level.
Kevin T: implementation note: routing decision must be idempotent and include chosen variant + kernel/quantization profile so ops can repro. include `X-RW-Variant: redwood-v1-q4` in response.
Sasha R: rollback plan? if rollout spikes latencies, auto-fallback to original policy and mute overrides for 10m. add metric `override_throttled.count`.
Mike H: agreed. I'll draft RFC with header names, SDK shape, metrics list, and console wireframe.
Anya L: ping me on the RFC, also want a small end-to-end test harness that simulates quota exhaustion and validates fallback headers.
console-bot: note saved to /ops/proposals/routing-sdk-headers, FF path: route_headers_sdk, reviewers: @Anya L @Kevin T @Sasha R
Mike H: thanks — I'll open RFC this afternoon. :thumbsup:
